title: You Think Dopamine Measures Pleasure, Yet Expected Sweet Juice Fires Zero Extra Spikes
description:
You think dopamine is your brain's pleasure chemical! Yet expected sweet juice fires zero extra spikes! This is the true story of Wolfram Schultz's dopamine experiment. Here is what went wrong with the pleasure myth.
